steps.label: Prompt
steps.text:
Make a 30-second animated explainer for [your product], 16:9 at 1920x1080, 30 fps.

Before you design anything, learn the product: read [your product URL], and the codebase if you have it. Write down in one line what it does and who it is for, list its three strongest features, and show me that summary first.

Beats:
1. The problem, shown as a moment the viewer recognises.
2. What [your product] is, in one sentence.
3. How it works, in three simple steps.
4. One proof point: a number, a customer or a result.
5. Logo, promise and [your product URL].

Look: modern product explainer: real screens, kinetic type and clean diagrams in the brand's colours.

Words: short on-screen captions, one idea per line, never more than two lines on screen at once.

Sound: compose a short original track in code, or use a royalty-free one and tell me where it is from. Give every cut and reveal its own sound effect, land the cuts on the beat, and mix so nothing clips.

How to build it: draw every frame in code as a pure function of time (HTML, Canvas or SVG, Remotion or HyperFrames all work), render the frames headlessly and assemble an MP4 with the audio. Then watch your render at full speed and fix anything that feels slow, cramped, generic or off-brand before you hand it over.
